summary: deep_copy of the legacy LayoutRight host force mirror into the LMPDeviceLayout device view f_merge_copy aborts at runtime whenever the two layouts differ (KOKKOS_LAYOUT=default on a GPU backend); VerletKokkos, from which this code was copied, correctly uses view_hostkk().
failure_scenario: cmake -D KOKKOS_LAYOUT=default with Kokkos_ENABLE_CUDA (or HIP/SYCL), any input that runs `dynamical_matrix` with at least one force style executing on the host (execute_on_host true, e.g. a non-kokkosable bond or kspace style): the run aborts inside Kokkos::deep_copy with "deep_copy given views that would require a temporary allocation".  Independently, even under KOKKOS_LAYOUT=legacy the copy takes the legacy double mirror instead of the KK host mirror that host force styles actually accumulate into (and skips verlet's sync_legacy_to_hostkk()), so the host contributions are silently dropped whenever NEED_TRANSFORM is true.
suggested_fix: Mirror VerletKokkos: call atomKK->k_f.sync_legacy_to_hostkk() and deep_copy from atomKK->k_f.view_hostkk(), whose layout and value type match DAT::t_kkacc_1d_3 by construction.

summary: Same defect as dynamical_matrix_kokkos.cpp:287 - deep_copy of the legacy LayoutRight host force mirror into the LMPDeviceLayout device view f_merge_copy aborts when the layouts differ (KOKKOS_LAYOUT=default on a GPU backend).
failure_scenario: cmake -D KOKKOS_LAYOUT=default with a CUDA/HIP/SYCL backend, `third_order` command with any host-executed force style: Kokkos throws "deep_copy given views that would require a temporary allocation" and the run aborts.  Under legacy layout the copy silently reads the wrong (legacy) mirror whenever NEED_TRANSFORM is true.
suggested_fix: Use atomKK->k_f.sync_legacy_to_hostkk() followed by deep_copy from atomKK->k_f.view_hostkk(), as VerletKokkos does.

summary: force_clear for the host path zeroes the legacy LayoutRight host mirror of f instead of the Kokkos host mirror that host-executed styles accumulate into, so under NEED_TRANSFORM (default layout on GPU, or any single-precision build) the buffer merged back at line 287 is never cleared.
failure_scenario: GPU build with KOKKOS_LAYOUT=default (or any LMP_KOKKOS_SINGLE_* build, where NEED_TRANSFORM is also true) running `dynamical_matrix` with a host-executed bonded style: host force contributions from the previous column are not cleared and are re-added each step, giving a wrong dynamical matrix.  Same code at src/KOKKOS/third_order_kokkos.cpp:232.
suggested_fix: Zero atomKK->k_f.view_hostkk() and call atomKK->k_f.modify_hostkk_legacy(), and use sync_pinned(HostKK,...) as VerletKokkos does.

summary: Same as dynamical_matrix_kokkos.cpp:232 - the host force buffer is zeroed on the legacy LayoutRight mirror instead of the Kokkos host mirror that host-executed styles write, and the following modify_hostkk_legacy() is missing.
failure_scenario: GPU build with KOKKOS_LAYOUT=default (or any LMP_KOKKOS_SINGLE_* build), `third_order` with a host-executed bonded/kspace style: stale host forces are not cleared and are re-added, corrupting the third-order tensor.
suggested_fix: Zero atomKK->k_f.view_hostkk(), call modify_hostkk_legacy(), and sync_pinned(HostKK,...) as VerletKokkos does.
